prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: master application icon for ArzFlow, a personal Windows automation utility
Primary request: create one original abstract symbol with no letters, no wordmark, and no resemblance to any existing AI-company logo
Subject: a single continuous ribbon forming a compact flowing loop with three softly folded paths, suggesting automation, transitions, and reliable return to the starting state
Style/medium: minimal vector-friendly geometric mark rendered as a polished app icon symbol, strong silhouette, memorable at 16–32 pixels
Composition/framing: centered symbol filling roughly 72 percent of a square canvas, balanced negative space, no enclosing rounded-square container
Color palette: coral-to-warm-red primary ribbon with a small mint-to-cyan transition on one fold; retain strong contrast in both light and dark UI
Materials/textures: subtly dimensional satin-glass ribbon, crisp edges, minimal highlight, no complex reflections
Constraints: genuinely transparent background and preserved alpha; no text, no initials, no A, no Z, no gradients outside the symbol, no shadow extending beyond the symbol, no mockup, no watermark, no resemblance to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, or other recognizable brand marks
